# Draft:King Nut Company

----
King Nut Company
King Nut Company is a privately held American snack food manufacturer based in Solon, Ohio. A subsidiary of Kanan Enterprises, Inc., the company specializes in the production and distribution of nuts, snack mixes, dried fruits, pretzels, and candy. It provides branded and private-label products to airlines, foodservice providers, vending operators, retailers, and convenience stores throughout the United States.
Overview
Founded: 1927
Headquarters: Solon, Ohio, U.S.
Parent Company: Kanan Enterprises, Inc.
Industry: Food manufacturing
Employees: 400+
Products: Nuts, snack mixes, dried fruits, candy, pretzels
Markets Served: Retail, airlines, foodservice, vending, convenience stores, private label
Annual Production: Approx. 750 million snack packages
Operations
King Nut Company operates out of three production facilities in Solon, Ohio, with a combined footprint of approximately 350,000 square feet. These facilities manage roasting, seasoning, blending, and packaging of snack products and support a range of services including private labeling, contract manufacturing, and custom snack formulation.
The company is a major snack supplier to the airline industry, providing in-flight snack packages for major U.S. carriers such as Delta Air Lines, American Airlines, Southwest Airlines, and United Airlines. Its scalable operations and facility investments have allowed it to support continued growth in both domestic and global markets.
Products
Nuts: Almonds, cashews, peanuts, pistachios, walnuts
Snack Mixes: Trail mixes, spicy blends, party mixes
Dried Fruits: Cranberries, mangoes, apricots, raisins
Confections: Chocolate- and yogurt-covered nuts and fruits
Pretzels & Crackers: Mini twists, nuggets, seasoned varieties
Certifications
King Nut Company is certified under the BRC Global Food Safety Standard and has achieved an AA rating, the highest grade possible. This certification reflects the company’s strong commitment to food safety, quality assurance, and rigorous compliance with international food manufacturing standards. Many of its products also carry kosher certification.
Leadership
As of 2025, King Nut Company’s executive team includes:
Martin Kanan – President & CEO
Matthew Kanan – Executive Vice President, Sales & Marketing
Joseph Valenza – Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
Jay Babka – Vice President, Manufacturing & Plant Operations
Justin Rosenberg – Vice President and Controller
Mike Smith – Vice President, Engineering
Paul Storsin – Vice President of Quality Assurance and Food Safety
Sonia LeBron – Vice President, Human Resources
Brands and Subsidiaries
King Nut Company operates several brands under the Kanan Enterprises umbrella, each targeting specific market segments:
King Nut – Core brand for bulk and portioned snacks
Peterson’s Gourmet Nuts & Snacks – Premium and gift-oriented snack line
Summer Harvest Brands – Snack Foods – Traditional and seasonal snack offerings
Nature’s Basics – Naturally sourced, minimally processed snack products
We Eat Smart – Gluten-free snacks focused on clean-label, better-for-you ingredients
